messages:
ana (producer): Uploaded first cut + transcript for StratusGrid case study: https://files.redwood/stratusgrid-cut1.mp4 + sg-transcript.txt. Want quick legal review and a short hero quote. Proposed embargo 2025-06-12 08:00 PT.

marta (prod-marketing): Thanks Ana. Can we aim for a very short hero (<= 12 words)? Also planning to split into a long form blog + 60s social clip.

ana (producer): small correction: ana (producer) — the hero options in the transcript are marked Q1/Q2. Paste below.

ana (producer): Transcript snippet: "Q1: Redwood let us scale inference without re-architecting; cost dropped 2.8x. Q2: We saw fewer OOMs and predictable P95 latency."

ben (legal): Quick flags: avoid absolute terms like "without" (use "with minimal") and the exact multiplier needs finance confirmation. Replace "2.8x" with "~3x" or attach benchmark appendix. Also remove any customer-owned telemetry screenshots unless customer signed asset release for raw logs.

marta (prod-marketing): Proposed hero (short): "Redwood enabled StratusGrid to scale inference with predictable performance." Alternate CTA hero for conversion test: "Cut inference spend by ~3x and keep tail latency steady."

leo (design): I'll mock both hero variants for the landing. We should also test two CTAs: Register for webinar vs. Read the deep dive.

sam (sales-ops): Routing: when the landing form is submitted, tag leads with utm_campaign=stratusgrid-case and route to queue SDR-CaseStudies. Sample webhook: ```curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood/lead -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","source":"case-stratusgrid","queue":"SDR-CaseStudies"}'```

marta (prod-marketing): Webinar? I propose a 45-min technical session with StratusGrid eng + Redwood infra eng two weeks after embargo. Helps move SQL/infra buyers. Thoughts?

ana (producer): Confirmed speakers. I'll collect 3 bullet demo agenda and a single-slide checklist for CS.

ben (legal): I'll approve wording that reads: "Redwood helped StratusGrid reduce inference costs ~3x while maintaining predictable tail latency." Need final transcript and the benchmark appendix attached to the approval email. Also confirm release form signed by StratusGrid rep.

marta (prod-marketing): We have signed release (attached in Drive). Use short quote for hero, longer quote can go in the sidebar with specifics and a link to appendix.

leo (design): Note for localization: we need variants of hero at 1200x628 and 1080x1080. I'll push assets by Friday.

sam (sales-ops): I'll create the tag automation: on lead.source=="case-stratusgrid" set campaign=stratusgrid-q2-2025 and slack notify #sdr-case-studies. Also will add lead scoring rule: +20 if attendee of webinar.

ana (producer): Quick content ask: can marketing ops add a hidden field for buyer role so we can route PM/Eng to product-led SDR vs. infra to solutions? Sample values: role=eng|pm|infra.

sam (sales-ops): Yep. Hidden input role -> mapping: eng->Solutions-Eng, infra->Platform-Sales, pm->Product-SDR. I'll document mapping.

launch-bot: asset upload complete: stratusgrid-cut1.mp4 (143MB)

marta (prod-marketing): Timeline summary:
- Legal sign-off + appendix: by 2025-06-02
- Final edit + social assets: by 2025-06-06
- Landing + lead routing in place: by 2025-06-09
- Embargo/publish: 2025-06-12 08:00 PT
- Webinar: 2025-06-26 10:00 PT
Please tag blockers here.

ben (legal): I'll send approval email once appendix and transcript are attached.

leo (design): I'll post the hero mocks in #design-requests and add alt copy for A/B test.

ana (producer): Noted on brand: please no third-party logos on the landing. StratusGrid asked for their logo only and a short tagline approval.

marta (prod-marketing): We'll do a small internal prerelease: product marketing + sales get early access. Please don't share externally until embargo lifts.

sam (sales-ops): Smoke test plan: simulate sample lead and check routing on 2025-06-09 09:00 PT.

ana (producer): Closing — will upload final cut and one-pager for CS. Ping me if legal requests changes.

ben (legal): Approval email queued (pending attachments).

marta (prod-marketing): Great work team. Ending thread.
